definitions.acc: temporal ACC (primary): per grid point centred correlation over time of forecast vs observed anomalies (training climatology), cos(lat)-weighted mean; null = undefined (zero-anomaly forecast)
definitions.acc_spatial: secondary: daily spatial correlation of anomalies, averaged over days
definitions.skill: 1 - error_model/error_reference for RMSE/MAE; references: climatology and anomaly_persistence
definitions.ridge: per grid point and lead; features lags 0..6 + mean(t-29..t) of anomalies; fit on 1982-2015; alpha chosen on validation RMSE (one per region and lead)
